decision_status: evidence-selected first recipe; not yet a tool-specific certified optimum

geometry_contract.working_target: raised silicon replicas of the Metal-1 wiring

selected_baseline.mask_transfer: printed polymer; optional thin angled Cr cap

selection_rationale: Same SF6/O2-on-silicon chemistry and an Oxford ICP tool class.
Directly compared polymer, Cr, SiO2, and Cr-on-polymer masks.
Optimized the relevant failure mode: lateral undercut at high aspect ratio.
Published structures were much smaller than the 2.6 um minimum opening here.
High source power and low platen power separate radical generation from ion damage.
The higher-rate 92/8 branch is retained only as a throughput bound because its published high-rate profile bottled and had 40-60 nm sidewall undulation.

initial_prediction_contract.target_profile: continuous raised Metal-1 replica without neck loss or grass
initial_prediction_contract.claim_boundary: The literature depth is a starting interval, not a prediction for an unspecified etcher. Tool-specific wafer flux, self-bias, thermal contact, and printed-polymer response remain propagated inputs until measured.

minimal_derivative_board.purpose: depth linearity and onset of transport limitation
narrower ion angle and reduced scattering
collisional angular broadening and passivation sensitivity

experimental_decision_rule: Reject any condition with grass, mask collapse, disconnected tracks, or local neck loss.
Among survivors, minimize maximum absolute lateral edge error across all layout components.
Then minimize within-cell and across-sample depth nonuniformity.
Use etch rate only as the final tie-breaker.

literature_bounds.result: controlled approximately 20 nm trenches at aspect ratio about 8
literature_bounds.role: oxygen-rich, extreme-resolution passivation bound; not the preferred transfer point

literature_bounds.result: 3.28 um/min over 10 min, but bottle profile and 40-60 nm sidewall undulation at the tabulated high-rate point
literature_bounds.role: throughput bound; rejected as first fidelity recipe
